task: Train one refactored model per project and compare it with the historical project models.
why: A global chronological split does not represent every project in the test set.
Per-project evaluation is more comparable with the historical experiments.

notes: The same 60/20/20 chronological strategy is applied independently to every project.
Rows with invalid sprint-entry timestamps are excluded by the refactored loader.

findings: Per-project training restores test coverage for all six projects.
AUC-PRC must be interpreted relative to each project's positive prevalence.
next_steps: Select hyperparameters using unweighted validation AUC-PRC.
